import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;

    static int[] v = new int[M];
    static int[] w = new int[M];
    static int[] next = new int[M];
    static int[] head = new int[N];
    static int e;

    static void addEdge(int u, int vv, int ww) {
        v[e] = vv; w[e] = ww; next[e] = head[u]; head[u] = e++;
        v[e] = u; w[e] = 0; next[e] = head[vv]; head[vv] = e++;
    }

    static int S, T;
    static int[] dist = new int[N];
    static int[] q = new int[N*2];
    static int[] arc = new int[N];
    static int[] gap = new int[N];
    static int[] inq = new int[N];
    static int[] pre = new int[N];

    static int SAP(int s, int t) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            arc[i] = -1;
            pre[i] = -1;
            inq[i] = 0;
            dist[i] = 0;
            gap[i] = 0;
        }
        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        q[qr++] = t; inq[t] = 1; gap[0]++; dist[t] = 0;
        while (qf < qr) {
            int u = q[qf++];
            for (int i = head[u]; i != -1; i = next[i]) {
                if (inq[v[i]] == 0) {
                    int vv = v[i];
                    q[qr++] = vv;
                    inq[vv] = 1;
                    dist[vv] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[vv]]++;
                    arc[vv] = head[vv];
                }
            }
        }
        int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
        pre[s] = s;
        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean flag = false;
            int i = arc[u];
            while (i != -1) {
                if (w[i] > 0 && dist[v[i]] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    flag = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, w[i]);
                    pre[v[i]] = u;
                    u = v[i];
                    if (u == t) {
                        while (u != s) {
                            u = pre[u];
                            w[arc[u]] -= low;
                            w[arc[u] ^ 1] += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    arc[u] = i; // update arc[u] to current edge
                    break;
                }
                i = next[i];
            }
            if (flag) continue;
            int mindis = t + 1;
            int best = -1;
            for (int j = head[u]; j != -1; j = next[j]) {
                if (w[j] > 0 && mindis > dist[v[j]]) {
                    mindis = dist[v[j]];
                    best = j;
                }
            }
            arc[u] = best;
            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return ans;
            dist[u] = mindis + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = pre[u];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static char[][] str = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] str2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] ca = new int[12][12];
    static int[][][] stone = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] dp = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, t;

    static void expand() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 1)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 1;
                    else if (stone[k-1][i][j] == 2)
                        stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                    else {
                        int nx, ny;
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
                            nx = i + dir[z][0];
                            ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (stone[k-1][nx][ny] == 2)
                                    stone[k][i][j] = 2;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][] vis = new int[12][12];
    static void dfs(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        vis[nowx][nowy] = 1;
        dp[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if (k >= t || stone[k][nowx][nowy] != 0) return;
        int nx, ny;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
            nx = nowx + dir[z][0];
            ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                if (stone[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                dfs(x, y, nx, ny, k+1);
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        t = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (str[i][j] == 'Z')
                    stone[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (str[i][j] == 'Y')
                    stone[0][i][j] = 1;
                else
                    sci[i][j] = str[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                str2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (str2[i][j] >= '0' && str2[i][j] <= '9')
                    ca[i][j] = str2[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }

        expand();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 1; a <= n; ++a)
                        for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b)
                            vis[a][b] = 0;
                    dfs(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int k = 1; k <= t; ++k) {
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                            dp[k][x][y][nx][ny] += dp[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        S = 0;
        T = n*n*2 + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) head[i] = -1;
        e = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addEdge(S, (i-1)*n + j, sci[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                addEdge(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, ca[i][j]);
            }
        }
        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x) {
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y) {
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx) {
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny) {
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && ca[nx][ny] != 0) {
                            if (dp[t][x][y][nx][ny] != 0)
                                addEdge((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        int ans = SAP(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
